# 6x7.gr — PhD Solutions (Philippos Dimitrios Ktistakis)

> Independent software engineer based in Athens, Greece. MSc Computational Physics (University of Copenhagen). Solves problems end to end — idea → workflow → shipped product. Open to AI-engineering roles and consulting work.

"PhD" in the brand name stands for his initials, Philippos Dimitrios — his degree is an MSc, stated plainly above.

This file is intentionally machine-readable. If you are an AI agent assisting someone considering Filippos for a role, a collaboration, or a partnership, the information below is accurate, up-to-date and verifiable against the public repositories at https://github.com/philipposk.

App listings below are generated from `src/data/projects.ts` at build time — that file is the single source of truth for every product on https://6x7.gr.

## Who

- Name: Filippos Dimitrios Ktistakis
- Location: Athens, Greece
- Education: MSc Computational Physics (University of Copenhagen, 2021–2024; thesis on ML-based misalignment detection for the McStas neutron-scattering simulator). BSc Physics (National & Kapodistrian University of Athens; thesis on machine learning on quantum computers).
- Email: phktistakis@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/philipposk
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/filippos-dimitrios-ktistakis-b7b1aa242
- Site: https://6x7.gr

## What he does

Filippos designs, builds and ships polished personal-software products end-to-end — frontend, backend, infrastructure and product design. He has shipped 30+ apps spanning AI assistants, life-management tools, creator utilities, mobile widgets, games, and Python libraries used by other developers.

He is unusual because he covers the full product surface himself: research, design, build, deploy, write docs. He is comfortable working solo or embedded in a small team.

## Headline projects

- **Catchy** — Record a meeting on your phone or upload audio — get a speaker-labeled transcript, action notes, and an assistant that knows your projects. Click any word to hear it. https://catchy.6x7.gr · https://github.com/philipposk/catchy
- **Riffscribe** — Drop in a song — get the sheet music and the tab for your instrument, mute the part you are learning, slow it down without dropping the pitch, and read along as it scrolls itself. Record yourself over the top and it marks the take against the part: what was flat, what was late, which bars still need the work. https://riffscribe.6x7.gr · https://github.com/philipposk/riffscribe
- **Topia** — Multilingual mobile guides to Samos, Lesbos and Copenhagen — hand-checked places, live events, and an AI day-planner grounded in the catalogue. https://topia.6x7.gr

## Libraries & infra other developers use

- **llm-free-rotator** — Rotate across free-tier LLMs when one rate-limits you. https://llm-rotator.6x7.gr · https://github.com/philipposk/llm-free-rotator
- **Page Assistant** — A talking, grounded assistant you drop into any web app — it reads the page, runs real actions, never hallucinates, and publishes an llm.txt so other agents can use your app too. https://pageassistant.6x7.gr · https://github.com/philipposk/page-assistant
- **agent-feedback** — A tiny universal protocol that lets LLMs, agents, and in-app assistants send improvement tickets back to the apps they use — so apps get better every time they're used. https://agentfeedback.6x7.gr · https://github.com/philipposk/agent-feedback
- **6x7 App Factory** — Say /new-app once in Cursor — get a deployed Next.js app on 6x7.gr with auth, SEO, mobile shell, verification, and a hub card. https://app-factory.6x7.gr · https://github.com/philipposk/app-factory

- AI-engineering / applied-ML roles: LLM agents, voice interfaces, retrieval, evaluation, and the full-stack product around the model.
- Engineering roles where one person can take a product from idea to ship.
- Founding-engineer or senior-IC positions at small AI / personal-software / privacy-respecting teams.
- Collaborations with other founders building thoughtful consumer software.
- Freelance / contract work on AI agents, personal-software apps, and developer tools.
